what: On a dark plate, a sphere of 2,600 dots in the center (32% of the plate’s short side), tilted up .32 rad, turns at 24° per second. Within a 10s cycle, at 1.5s it breaks into a scattered cloud (dots sizzling) over .5s, condenses from the cloud into a donut ring over .6s and spins 1.8s, then returns cloud .6s → sphere .6s and rests 4.4s (changes use smoothstep). Back dots are faint (opacity .28~.9) — the ‹live video› slot of the first work card in the portfolio

options.size: Sphere radius (ratio of the plate’s short side), default .32

note: The original is a 60fps 10s webm video (dot sphere ↔ company symbol). The symbol isn’t carried over and was replaced with a donut ring. It pauses when off screen, and with reduced motion it shows a single still sphere.

from.where: index.html .xa-case.is-first — original first Work card SkyStage video (sphere 0–1.5s · cloud 2s · symbol 2.6–4.4s · cloud 5s · sphere 5.6–10s)
